description: This file contains utility functions for file content reading, property extraction, file type checking, directory searching, and variable expansion, primarily used within a C++ project. It defines inline functions within the Utils namespace, including methods for reading properties from files, reading file contents, checking if a path is a regular file, recursive file searching with pattern matching, and variable expansion in strings.

methods.name: readPropertyFromFile
methods.description: Reads a property value from a specified file, with support for recursive expansion if the value starts with '$'.

methods.name: readFileContent
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a specified file into a string.

methods.name: isRegularFile
methods.description: Checks if a given path corresponds to a regular file.

methods.name: searchFilesRec
methods.description: Recursively searches directories for files matching patterns, with exclusions and result cap.

methods.name: searchFiles
methods.description: Initiates recursive directory search with specified parameters.

methods.name: ExpandPropertiesInString
methods.description: Expands variables within a string by replacing them with property values read from a file.
